workLog.step: Fixed #3626. Four occurrences of a doubled artifact root, .agents/sessions/.agents/sessions/, remained in the session-init skill. Line 352 is executable: it pointed validate_session_json.py at a path that cannot exist, so an agent following the skill literally would fail its own session-end validation. Repaired the canonical skill and regenerated the Copilot mirror.

Fixed #3624. ADR-063 attributed the semantic / episodic / causal taxonomy to ADR-007. ADR-007's four tiers are storage backends (AgentDB, ReasoningBank, SQLite, JSON fallback); the semantic / episodic / causal taxonomy is ADR-038. Repointed the ADR-063 alternatives table and the triage eval fixture, which also asked for four tiers naming only two and predated ADR-089 removing Tier 3.
